description: [github] Get metadata for one public repository you already know by owner and name: description, stars, forks, language, license, topics, url and last push time. Use github_search_repos first if you only have keywords. Returns an error if the repo does not exist or is private.

owner.description: User or organization that owns the repo, e.g. 'cloudflare'

repo.description: Repository name only, without the owner, e.g. 'workers-sdk'

name: github_repo
title: GitHub: repo
